title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Scheduled task emails to other users**: Scheduled tasks in Genie One can now send emails to other users in your organization, not just to you. See [Scheduled tasks](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#scheduled-tasks).
* **Mobile app links**: Links to Genie One chats and published dashboards now open directly in the Genie mobile app on iOS and Android. See [Use Genie on mobile](/aws/en/genie-one/mobile).
